info.brief: Functions and constants for interacting with the KaiAds SDK.
info.description: Functions and constants for interacting with the KaiAds SDK.

elements.name: kaiads.set_listener
elements.description: Listen to events from the KaiAds SDK.

parameters.name: listener
parameters.doc: function to call when a KaiAds event is received from the SDK.

parameters.name: config
parameters.doc: Ad configuration as a JSON encoded string.

elements.name: kaiads.show
elements.description: Show an ad. You must have called preload() and received a callback that the ad was preloaded before attempting to show an ad.

elements.name: kaiads.PRELOAD_ERROR
elements.brief: Event sent when an error occurred while trying to preload an ad
elements.description: Event sent when an error occurred while trying to preload an ad

elements.name: kaiads.PRELOAD_OK
elements.brief: Event sent when an ad was successfully preloaded
elements.description: Event sent when an ad was successfully preloaded

elements.name: kaiads.SHOW_ERROR
elements.brief: Event sent when an error occurred while trying to show an ad
elements.description: Event sent when an error occurred while trying to show an ad

elements.name: kaiads.AD_DISPLAY
elements.brief: Event sent when an ad is displayed
elements.description: Event sent when an ad is displayed

elements.name: kaiads.AD_CLICK
elements.brief: Event sent when an ad is clicked
elements.description: Event sent when an ad is clicked

elements.name: kaiads.AD_CLOSE
elements.brief: Event sent when an ad is closed
elements.description: Event sent when an ad is closed
